def bootstrap_ci(data, n_boot=10000, ci=0.95, seed=42):
    rng = np.random.RandomState(seed)

    boot_means = np.array([rng.choice(data, size=n, replace=True).mean() for _ in range(n_boot)])

    return data.mean(), lo, hi

def bootstrap_diff_ci(a, b, n_boot=10000, ci=0.95, seed=42):

    rng = np.random.RandomState(seed)
